title: Te Kākano o te Taupatupatu
intro: I mua i te mōhio o te ao ki te pakanga whānui, ka puta he whakamātautau nui o te whakapono me te ngohengohe. Ka tūhuratia e tēnei kōrero ngā kōwhiringa a tētahi tangata, ā, ko āna mahi he tauira mō ngā whakatipuranga o muri mai. Kia rite ki te wetewete i te kōrero mō tētahi wairua e raru ana i te hae nui me ōna hua kino.
clues: Ko au tētahi o ngā uri tuatahi i haere i te whenua, he tama nā te tokorua tuatahi.
I whakahaua māua ko tōku tuakana kia tapae patunga tapu ki a Allah, hei whakamātautau i tō māua pono.
Kāore taku whakahere i manakohia, engari ko tā tōku tuakana i manakohia, ā, i whakakīia tōku ngākau e te kare ā-roto kino.
I kōrero ahau i ngā kupu whakawehi ki tōku tuakana, i te kawa o te whakakorenga.
I whakautu mai tōku tungāne me te whakaaro nui me te karakia, hei whakamahara mai i te tika o Allah me te wehi ki a Ia.
Ahakoa ngā kupu māhaki a tōku tungāne me tōna hiahia ki te muru hara, i whakamatea e au tētahi tangata, ā, ka noho ko tētahi o te hunga i hinga.

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
